verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for an API platform that ships SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any opt-out control for telemetry or usage tracking. Items about call-recording defaults, analytics features and the MCP server are unrelated to the product's own telemetry and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
